answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 21160 Country: India Title: my uncle have purchased a land which was encroached illegally by others beside a mosque. My uncle knew that the land is encroached. now he wants to give that land to masjid , is it permissible to give that land to construct the masjid. Question: As salam alalikum mufti sahab. my uncle have purchased a land which was encroached illegally by others beside a mosque. My uncle knew that the land is encroached. now he wants to give that land to masjid , is it permissible to give that land to construct the masjid. Answer ID: 21160 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 464/464/M=1431) Yes, if your uncle endows his owned land for mosque, the mosque can be constructed over there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
